title: Volcano Engine Launches Seedance 2.5 API, Video Generation Capabilities Fully Upgraded

content_html:
Volcano Engine has officially launched the Seedance 2.5 API service today. The new version has been upgraded in terms of instruction following, long narratives, realism, and audio-visual quality compared to Seedance 2.0, further enhancing AI video generation capabilities.

Seedance 2.5 supports direct output of 30-second videos natively, with a maximum of 50 multimodal material references, and offers more accurate and stable video editing capabilities. It also supports more than a dozen languages. The model has been further optimized in key video elements such as image quality, audio quality, lighting, camera movement, and overall aesthetics, making AI-generated content closer to cinematic long narrative effects.

Volcano Engine stated that enterprise practices show that the realism and visual quality of video generation are important foundations for expanding commercial applications. The upgrade of Seedance 2.5 will provide more possibilities for scenarios such as creative advertising and industrial simulation.

Currently, Seedance 2.5 has been synchronized and launched on platforms such as LibTV, Qixiang AI, TapNow, Panqu AI, DreamWeaver Workshop AI, and Xingyu Film Scene, offering enterprises and creators more AI video production tools.

In addition, Seedance 2.0 mini and Seedance 2.0 fast are now available with limited-time discounts. From August 7th to September 7th, Seedance 2.0 mini will be billed at 40% of the standard rate, with a minimum cost of approximately 0.2 yuan per second for 720P; Seedance 2.0 fast will be billed at 75% of the standard rate, with a minimum cost of approximately 0.6 yuan per second for 720P. This upgrade and pricing strategy further lowers the barrier to AI video creation, accelerating the application of generative video technology in commercial fields.

content_html_zh:
火山引擎今天正式推出 Seedance 2.5 API 服务。 新版本较Seedance 2.0在指令跟随、长篇叙事、真实感、视听质量等方面进行了升级，进一步增强了AI视频生成能力。

Seedance 2.5原生支持直接输出30秒视频，最多支持50个多模态素材参考，并提供更准确、稳定的视频编辑能力。 它还支持十多种语言。 该模型在图像质量、音频质量、灯光、镜头移动、整体美观等关键视频元素上进行了进一步优化，使AI生成的内容更接近电影长篇叙事效果。

火山引擎表示，企业实践表明，视频生成的真实感和视觉质量是拓展商业应用的重要基础。 Seedance 2.5的升级将为创意广告、工业模拟等场景提供更多可能。

目前，Seedance 2.5已在LibTV、齐象AI、TapNow、盘曲AI、DreamWeaver Workshop AI、星宇影景等平台同步上线，为企业和创作者提供更多AI视频制作工具。

此外，Seedance 2.0 mini 和 Seedance 2.0 fast 现已推出限时折扣。 8月7日至9月7日，Seedance 2.0 mini将按标准费率的40%计费，720P最低费用约为0.2元/秒； Seedance 2.0 fast将按标准费率的75%计费，720P最低费用约为每秒0.6元。 此次升级和定价策略进一步降低了AI视频创作的门槛，加速了生成视频技术在商业领域的应用。
